cohen.message: Good morning. I found 3 decisions worth your attention.

recommendations.title: Confirm equipment for tomorrow's install
recommendations.summary: The Jobber job is scheduled tomorrow, but the outdoor-unit shipment is not confirmed.
recommendations.whyItMatters: A missed shipment could delay the install and create a same-day customer issue.
recommendations.confidenceReason: Jobber job and equipment checklist agree; shipment confirmation is missing.

recommendations.title: Follow up a high-value quote today
recommendations.summary: A heat-pump installation quote has passed the normal follow-up window with no customer response.
recommendations.whyItMatters: The opportunity is still active and a timely follow-up may protect the sale.
recommendations.confidenceReason: Jobber shows no response after the most recent quote activity.

recommendations.title: Review vendor bill due in 3 business days
recommendations.summary: A vendor invoice has been captured and is approaching its due date.
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reviewing it now reduces the chance of a missed bill or duplicate entry.
recommendations.confidenceReason: Invoice email and accounting record reference match.

health.label: All current JSA evidence accounted for
